items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that Fat Anthony? [INTERVIEWEE] Tuba Fats? That's Tuba Fats, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. And it was the revived Tuxedo Band and also something called the Last, no. Chosen Few Band was the other band.
Tuba Fats? That's Tuba Fats, yeah.
